matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 341-350 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages match the current extraction and no new correction is needed. Pages 345 and 349 retain earlier complete visual reviews and are intentionally omitted from this bundle's matching-page list so those prior dispositions remain authoritative on replay. It also preserves duplicated names and identifiers, rank variants, nonnumeric prefixed identifiers, clipped notes such as also AS, folders s, possibly, possible, file sent t, ASN fragments, recomm, one fold, and aka Regi, isolated box-number anomalies, and mixed /05, /06, and /07 archive locations.
